vendorProject.description: Vendor or project name for the vulnerability

dateReported.description: Date the vulnerability was added to the catalog

originSource.description: Name of specific CNW member initially monitoring the vulnerability exploitation; CNW if monitored by multiple CNW members / in case of undisclosed reporting; EUI for EU institutions; CRA for mandatory reporting according to Cyber Resilience Act; CPP for ENISA Cyber Partnership Programme, ENISA for ENISA CTI

exploitationType.description: Ransomware if known to have been used by a ransomware group; APT if known to have been used by an unspecific state-nexus groups; unknown if the reporting party lacks confirmation that the vulnerability has been utilized by a specific entity

threatActorsExploiting.description: Threat Actors known for exploiting the vulnerability

cwes.description: Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) codes associated with this vulnerability

notes.description: Additional notes related to the vulnerability listing
